from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyExpenseRecord(BaseModel):
    """Administrative expense data extracted from one company's financial document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the document belongs to")
    administrative_expense_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the administrative expense as reported")
    expense_unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the reported amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    expense_line_label: str | None = Field(description="The specific line item label used in the document for the expense")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the financial statement")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the expense amount and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_expense_records: list[CompanyExpenseRecord]
